svg.text: Canada’s connections: country reference and city-coordinate tasks
Original educational map • flat latitude/longitude reference • not equal area or ground distance
Green: Canada and the two focus countries (United States, Haiti). Grey: other country areas.
United States inset: place Pasadena at 34.1°N, 118.1°W
Minor inset lines: 0.1°. Values are explicitly rounded city-region references, not a surveyed address.
Country outlines: Natural Earth public-domain Admin 0 (generalised/de facto; not a legal boundary ruling).
City sources: NASA Terrestrial Coordinates (Pasadena); UNGEGN/UN Cartographic Section (Port-au-Prince).
Use an appropriately labelled globe/second view for transfer; these flat panels do not preserve ground distance.
